workload: T = 1 decode GEMV, captured float32 activations of one real decode step, one launch per matrix
pipelined_inputs: xs[0] is the captured vector (every parity and synced row); xs[1..QUEUE-1] are per-launch permutations of its 16-element blocks (same value multiset), rng default_rng(0), one set per matrix shared by every variant
variant_order: rotated by one per matrix (recorded per matrix)

prefill_path.call: model(ids[:n_prompt]) one shot, then one cached decode step; fused kernels at every tile

note: Diagnostic variants' outputs are wrong by construction (a stream removed); candidates' outputs are real and compared with the shipped resident call bit for bit and with the float64 canonical decode. Timing is the claim here; the parity suite is tests/test_qmetal.py.

inferred.occupancy_registers_cache: not observable from Python/MLX; inferred only from the deltas between variants (nox: activation traffic; noidx: index stream and the gather address pattern; nocb: the staged codebook gathers against a cost-matched bitcast stand-in; noexp: exponent stream and class; xonly: loads plus scale and reduction; empty: launch)
